criteria.title: Public relay bootstrap is canonical for core service/deployment state
criteria.assertion: The web app must bootstrap services, environments, artifacts, builds, deployment intents, and deployment runs from public relay read models authored by the advertised Bahia service pubkey rather than REST CRUD endpoints.

criteria.title: Service creation uses signer-first public command flow
criteria.assertion: Creating a service from `/services` must publish kind `5964` `ServiceCreate`, await a correlated `7963` result, and not require a REST `POST /api/v1/services` path in the current web route implementation.

criteria.title: Successful service creation immediately hydrates the services list
criteria.assertion: After a successful signer-first service-create command, `/services` must visibly show the created service in the same browser session without requiring manual refresh, navigation away, or waiting for incidental later projection visibility.

criteria.title: Deployment policy preview uses signer-first public request flow
criteria.assertion: The service-detail deployment modal must request policy preview through signer-first public kind `5989` rather than a REST `policies/evaluate` call.

criteria.title: Deployment policy preview is a required gate before intent creation
criteria.assertion: Deployment intent creation from `/services/[id]` must stay blocked until policy preview succeeds, and preview-reported blockers must prevent publishing the deployment-intent request.

criteria.title: Deployment intent creation uses signer-first public request/result flow
criteria.assertion: Creating a deployment intent from `/services/[id]` must publish kind `5961` with service/environment/artifact tags and await a correlated `7961` result.

criteria.title: Deployment approval uses signer-first public request/result flow
criteria.assertion: Approving a pending deployment from `/deployments/pending` must publish kind `5966` with intent/decision tags and await a correlated public result without relying on REST approve endpoints.

criteria.title: Deployment history stays reactive to relay-backed store state
criteria.assertion: `/deployments` must derive rendered intents from the shared relay-backed controlplane store so navigation is not stuck on a stale one-shot snapshot when later deployment projections arrive after route load.

criteria.title: Pending approvals stay reactive to relay-backed store state
criteria.assertion: `/deployments/pending` must derive pending intents from the shared relay-backed controlplane store so approved or rejected projection updates remove rows without REST refresh logic.

criteria.title: Browser-level signer-first journey proves the approved core flow
criteria.assertion: At least one browser E2E must prove the approved signer-first public journey covering immediate service-list hydration, successful policy preview, deployment intent creation, approval, and deployment history/detail rendering without REST CRUD mocks.

criteria.title: Core public deployment flow stays off encrypted request kind 5980
criteria.assertion: The selected core service-to-deployment browser journey must use public request kinds `5964`/`5989`/`5961`/`5966` and must not depend on encrypted request kind `5980`, which belongs to the separate encrypted run-log slice.

coverage_notes: HITL decisions resolved the previously open questions about immediate service-list hydration and policy-preview posture.
The approved acceptance contract now exceeds current verified behavior in two places: immediate `/services` hydration and policy-preview gating.
Relay-backed deployment history and pending-approval reactivity remain approved and still have passing evidence from the prior verification pass.
